subject: general
question: Seven people A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting in a row, facing the north. F sits sixth from the right end of the row. Only two people sit between E and F. A sits to the right of E but left of G. D sits third to the left of C. How many people sit to the right of B?
solution:
Seven people A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting in a row, facing the north.

 
• F sits sixth from the right end of the row.
 
• Only two people sit between E and F.
 
• A sits to the right of E but left of G.
 
• D sits third to the left of C

The Final Arrangement is,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b1c7b80f3a1ce83ffe373779f14a81c1733d67480975c1baa9afe62d0d3c0224.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**
